updates.diagnosis: Newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
updates.eligibility: IPI 2-5, with primary endpoint assessed in IPI 3-5; no universal molecular mutation requirement established in reviewed sources
updates.sponsor: Genmab; AbbVie collaborator; AbbVie Deutschland EU sponsor
updates.institution: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center investigator affiliation
updates.geography: Multinational; EU CTIS 2023-505277-32-00 includes 16 European countries
updates.endpoint: PFS in IPI 3-5; PFS in IPI 2-5
updates.event: Positive sponsor-reported Phase 3 top-line PFS: primary HR 0.49, 95% CI 0.35-0.69, p<0.0001; broader IPI 2-5 HR 0.49, 95% CI 0.36-0.67.
updates.limitations: Await peer-reviewed full numerical results, OS and detailed toxicity; current approval not established for the combination.

updates.eligibility: No mandatory tumor molecular alteration confirmed; MGMT used in adjusted analyses, survivin is the vaccine target
updates.intervention: SurVaxM plus standard therapy versus placebo plus standard therapy
updates.institution: Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center and 10 other US cancer centers
updates.event: Full-population OS 22.8 vs 20.3 months, HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.54-1.03), p=0.076 (not significant); prespecified age <=65 subgroup OS 24.2 vs 20.2 months, HR 0.64 (95% CI 0.44-0.93), p=0.019.
updates.limitations: Sponsor/institution results only; no peer-reviewed full report or ClinicalTrials.gov result tables independently verified. A subgroup result does not erase the nonsignificant full-population outcome.
